name: steph38ft
caption:
FROM 38 FEET? 🎮🏀 Tie game, overtime, in Oklahoma City. Steph pulls up from 38 feet.

• Feb 27, 2016, 0.6 seconds left
• Splash: we win 121-118
• His 12th three of the night, tying the then-NBA record (12 of 16)
• 46 points
• That season: the first unanimous MVP in NBA history

Is that Steph's greatest shot ever? 👇

beats.head: FROM 38 FEET?
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: Tie game in overtime. Steph Curry pulls up from thirty-eight feet.

beats.head: 0.6 SECONDS
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: February twenty-seventh, twenty sixteen, in Oklahoma City. Point six seconds left on the clock.

beats.head: BANG.
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: Splash. We win, one twenty-one to one eighteen.

beats.head: 12 THREES
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: That was his twelfth three of the night, tying what was then the NBA record. Forty-six points.

beats.head: UNANIMOUS
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: That season, he became the first unanimous MVP in NBA history.

beats.head: GREATEST SHOT?
beats.vo: Is that the greatest shot Steph has ever hit? Comment below.

facts.claim: Curry scored 46 points and made a 38-foot game-winning jump shot with 0.6 seconds remaining to beat the Oklahoma City Thunder (OKC) in overtime 121-118 (February 27, 2016); he tied the then-single-game three-point record (12); 2015-16: first (1st) player to be unanimously voted MVP The 12 threes tied what was then the NBA record (since broken).
